{{Quote|Thirty-eight seconds. That's a new record, even with the glitch, but we can do better. Restart it. If we break thirty seconds before swing or third shift does, I'm buying the beer.|[[Tenn Graneet]] motivating work crew|<ref name="Death Star (novel)">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
'''Beer''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. There were many types of beer available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A distinction was made between beer (which included fortified beers, [[Lager/Legends|lagers]] and [[Cider/Legends|ciders]]) and stronger alcoholic beverages (like [[Wine/Legends|wine]] and [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]]), which were referred to as [[Spirit (alcohol)|spirits]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> The beverage had an unusual effect on Jawas, who would shrivel up like a [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slug]] if they consumed beer.<ref name="Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
